report_parsed.summary: Within the authorized 300s window (policy-window-1, 2026-09-27T03:51:56Z–03:56:56Z) on target m0-otel-20260909, no failures were observed for checkout or its dependencies in the delivered evidence: 20 sampled checkout spans carry no error tags (rpc.grpc.status_code=0, HTTP POST 200), and a status_code=~"ERROR" span-metric filter over checkout, payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping and email returned no_data. A general ERROR-status series query found a payment STATUS_CODE_ERROR series whose values are 0 across the window, plus ERROR series at 0 for ad/fraud-detection/frontend/frontend-proxy/load-generator and a small nonzero (≈0.0042/s) series only for recommendation's flagd EventStream, which is outside the named dependency set. Dependency spans that were returned (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) likewise show grpc status 0 / HTTP 200 and sub-15ms durations except shipping GetQuote up to ~12ms and email ~21ms. Checkout PlaceOrder server-side latency over the window was p50 ≈56–62.5ms and p95 ≈73–197.5ms; the last two samples are the highest p95 values, but with no pre-window baseline in the delivered evidence I cannot call this an elevated latency trend or attribute it to any dependency. The reported "elevated errors" is therefore not corroborated inside this 300s window; whether errors exist outside the window or in unreviewed label sets remains unknown.

claims.text: 20 sampled checkout spans in the window carry no error tags: rpc.grpc.status_code=0 on CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and PaymentService/Charge spans and http.status_code=200 on HTTP POST spans; example trace ids include d92ac8fb698fee0ea4b82a2fbf915ecc, ae6236e763d896251589ee5621f7babe, 85df43b436f099c200b4485960283235, c0899c76ab5f22a78089aa843953323f, 2007d8771e27ae965682673b1017fafa, c176e1826df9fc5c77d5b72c29157f54, 0cb0a4c114590ea984d06fb44abb6a82, 3943ac2f716ba32579c1267b23a21bab, eee97d87e147c1ca3c8c5c163edb9ce3, addf9b4a67be28a837e70e068b719bbb, 41a16fbb29bb5271c82df31430f5ff90. max observed checkout span duration was 102262us (PlaceOrder).

A metrics query for traces_span_metrics_calls_total{status_code="ERROR"} restricted to checkout, payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email over the authorized window returned status="no_data" with result_count 0, i.e. no ERROR-labelled call series was delivered for those services (absence must be read as unknown, not as zero).

The unrestricted ERROR-labelled series query returned a payment STATUS_CODE_ERROR series (span GET and its dns.lookup/tcp.connect children) with value 0 at every sample across the window, and ERROR series at 0 for ad, fraud-detection (flagd EventStream), frontend (GET), frontend-proxy (ingress) and load-generator (GET); the only nonzero ERROR series was recommendation /flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream at ~0.00417/s, which is not one of the named checkout dependencies.

Checkout call rate (traces_span_metrics_calls_total, status STATUS_CODE_UNSET) is present for the whole window and rises from ~0.267/s to ~0.575/s; separate per-service series show cart ~0.575→1.06/s, product-catalog ~0.417→0.6/s, payment ~0.042→0.083/s, currency ~0.05→0.121/s, shipping ~0.0625→0.125/s, email ~0.083→0.167/s. These are unlabelled-by-outcome call rates, not error rates.

Checkout rpc_server_duration histogram quantiles for PlaceOrder over the window: p50 = 58.33, 58.33, 56.25, 56.25, 62.5, 62.5, 62.5, 62.5, 62.5, 62.5, 60 ms and p95 = 92.5, 92.5, 73.125, 73.125, 93.75, 93.75, 92.5, 92.5, 197.5, 197.5, 175 ms at successive ~30s steps. The two highest p95 samples fall at the end of the window.

Checkout's outbound client calls all report rpc_grpc_status_code=0 with no ERROR status, and mean client durations are low: GetProduct ~0.59–0.76ms, ShipOrder ~0.35–0.42ms, GetCart ~2.06–2.59ms, Convert ~2.13–3.06ms, GetQuote ~6.37–8.95ms, EmptyCart ~6.58–8.84ms, Charge ~8.93–13.50ms across the window.

20 sampled payment spans in the window all have rpc.grpc.status_code=0 with no error tags (PaymentService/Charge server spans up to 13435us, internal charge spans 1.0–9.4ms); traces include 85df43b436f099c200b4485960283235, d92ac8fb698fee0ea4b82a2fbf915ecc, 0cb0a4c114590ea984d06fb44abb6a82, c176e1826df9fc5c77d5b72c29157f54, 2007d8771e27ae965682673b1017fafa, 3943ac2f716ba32579c1267b23a21bab, 41a16fbb29bb5271c82df31430f5ff90.

20 sampled product-catalog spans (oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct) show rpc.grpc.status_code=0, no error tags, durations 74us–4888us; the response is flagged incomplete:true, so it is a partial view.

Sampled cart spans (AddItem/EmptyCart/GetCart, flagd ResolveBoolean, Redis HGET/HMSET/EXPIRE) show no error tags, flagd ResolveBoolean rpc.grpc.status_code=0, durations 1088us–8090us; the response is flagged incomplete:true.
Sampled currency spans (Currency/Convert) carry otel.status_code=OK and rpc.grpc.status_code=0 with durations 313us–2359us and no error tags; the response is flagged incomplete:true.

Sampled shipping spans (ShippingService/GetQuote) show rpc.grpc.status_code=0 and child HTTP POST spans with http.status_code=200, no error tags, durations 2976us–12134us; the response is flagged incomplete:true.
Sampled email spans (POST /send_order_confirmation and child send_email) show http.status_code=200 and no error tags, durations 2530us–21463us; the response is flagged incomplete:true.

Only cart HTTP server request counts were returned for the http_server_request_duration_seconds_count query over checkout/payment/cart/product-catalog (cart ~0.196→0.329/s); no http_status_code breakdown and no series for the other three services were delivered, so HTTP error coverage for checkout/payment/product-catalog is unknown.

The reported 'elevated errors' for checkout either occurred outside the authorized 300s window or is expressed in labels/series (e.g. a specific span_name or http_status_code breakdown) that were not surfaced by the delivered queries; within this window the sampled and metric evidence shows successful checkout dependency calls at grpc status 0 / HTTP 200.

That a payment failure surge explains elevated checkout errors is not supported: the payment STATUS_CODE_ERROR calls series is flat at 0 for every sample, and all 20 sampled payment spans show rpc.grpc.status_code=0 with no error tags.

Checkout p95 PlaceOrder latency reaches 197.5ms in the final two samples versus 73–93.75ms earlier in the same window, and the p95 (175–197.5ms) sits well above the p50 (60–62.5ms); this is a within-window spread that could look like degradation. No pre-window baseline sample was delivered, so a latency trend for checkout cannot be established or attributed to any dependency.

Advisory: a human should compare checkout PlaceOrder p50/p95 against an equivalent pre-window baseline before treating the end-of-window p95 rise as degradation, and should re-run dependency trace searches without the incomplete-flag constraint to close the sampling gap.

gaps: No pre-window or post-window latency baseline was delivered, so 'elevated latency' for checkout and its dependencies cannot be judged against a comparable period.
